## Gemini 4 Hydrogen API

Gemini 4 Hydrogen is a large language model by Google, available on the Venice API as `gemini-4-hydrogen`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Gemini 4 Hydrogen is Google's fast, efficient model for coding and agentic work, with a unified 1M token context window and tunable thinking.

### Gemini 4 Hydrogen API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-4-hydrogen` | Standard | Anonymized | $1.88 / $9.38 per 1M |

### Gemini 4 Hydrogen specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Google |
| Released | Nov 14, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 64K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Gemini 4 Hydrogen API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "gemini-4-hydrogen"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-hydrogen",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
